_about: Model preferences for the start-task skill, by tier. resolve-model.py picks, at run time, the first candidate that is in the harness's live catalog and answers a one-word ping. Patterns are shell globs, tried in order; several matches of one glob are tried newest version first. A repository can replace this whole file with its own .agents/models.json. Claude Code is not listed: its subagents use the aliases `opus` and `sonnet` in agents/*.md, which always resolve to the latest models. If nothing matches, the subagent inherits the main session's model.

strong.used_by: the reviewer subagent; also what to start the main session on (planning)

codex._note: OpenAI first (gpt-6-sol costs what Sonnet 5 costs, so it is the strong tier and fast drops one size to Luna; gpt-6-astra is left out on cost). Then the models a Codex pointed at a proxy offered on 2026-09-27: grok, deepseek, qwen, kimi, glm. Catalogs rarely overlap, so order between families matters little.
